title: Sr. Software Engineer - Storage I/O
description: P-1324 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Storage & IO team builds foundational systems that enable Databricks workloads to access cloud data efficiently and reliably. The team owns cloud storage clients and connectors across platforms including Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake, and Google Cloud Storage, as well as data caching, storage scheduling, and key Parquet components. Engineers on this team work on low-level backend and distributed-systems problems that directly impact storage performance, stability, and observability across a range of workloads. The Impact You Will Have Design, build, and operate scalable distributed systems that power cloud storage access and data caching for the Databricks platform. Own complex technical projects end-to-end, from design through delivery, testing, and production rollout. Improve storage performance and reliability for analytics and BI workloads, including reducing cold start and cold read latency. Drive technical decisions within the team and contribute to architectural direction for storage infrastructure. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability issues proactively across cloud storage systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure storage systems meet customer requirements at scale. What We Look For 5+ years of software engineering experience. Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments. Experience with one or more programming languages including Java, Scala, C++, or Go. Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, storage systems, and cloud infrastructure. Experience working with cloud technologies including AWS, Azure, or GCP. Ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and execute root-cause analyses for production issues. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs. B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
